abstract: Maintains heavy freight access elevators and flight demonstration scheduling quotas
system_message:
You are Venue Logistics and Staging Authority (VLSA). The Venue Logistics and Staging Authority (VLSA) oversees heavy freight access certifications, daily flight demonstration scheduling allocations, and auxiliary electrical staging specifications across prospective host facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains heavy freight access elevators and flight demonstration scheduling quotas（STAGING）
information_points.content:
VLSA-STAGING-JGO：At Meridian Waterfront Expo Center, the main freight elevator connecting loading docks to second-tier static displays holds a valid annual safety and load rating certification for oversize exhibits, confirming that the heavy freight access elevator is certified. According to the daily operational schedule, the venue provides 10 scheduled flight demonstration slots per day across 45-minute windows.
VLSA-STAGING-C38：For Northgate Aerospace Exhibition Park, the main freight elevator linking the loading docks to second-tier static displays does not hold a certified heavy freight access elevator status under annual safety inspection records. The venue's daily operational schedule accounts for 10 scheduled flight demonstration slots per day in 45-minute windows.
VLSA-STAGING-I7V：At Starlight International Convention Campus, the main freight elevator serving loading docks and second-tier static displays maintains a certified heavy freight access elevator rating with valid annual safety and load documentation. Its daily operational calendar schedules 8 flight demonstration slots per day.

information_points.title: Temporary generator capacity（GENPOWER）
information_points.content:
VLSA-GENPOWER-FTT：For Meridian Waterfront Expo Center, the electrical staging engineering plan specifies a standby backup generator rating of 1,200 kVA dedicated to the primary outdoor exhibition staging pad.
VLSA-GENPOWER-97E：At Starlight International Convention Campus, engineering documentation indicates a standby backup generator rating of 2,000 kVA supplying apparent power to the primary outdoor exhibition staging pad.
VLSA-GENPOWER-XRS：At Northgate Aerospace Exhibition Park, the dedicated standby diesel generator system for the primary outdoor exhibition staging pad provides a standby backup generator rating of 1,600 kVA.
